_note: Model chain per agent role, locked 2026-10-18 from real-task results (docs/SOURCES_AND_MODELS.md, research/eval/results.json). First entry is the primary; each later entry is the fallback if the one before it is rate limited or down. Every chain ends on the free nvidia tier. Provisional until the live agent loop is timed.

planner_writer.needs: Strong reasoning, long outputs, follows citation rules. Used by the planner, the drill-down planner and the report writer.

lane_agent.needs: Tool calling and exact quoting, fast. Used by the 4 lane agents (news, company, legal, science) and entity resolution.

verifier.needs: Strict judge of whether a quote supports a statement. Prefer a different model family from the lane agents so their mistakes are not repeated.
